notes.title: v1.1 patch is out
notes.content:
- Auto-building mode is now available on all buildings that are producing construction materials. Just flip the switch and the building will automatically produce all materials until the storage is full.
- Habitats are no longer producing construction materials. All materials previously produced by habitats are now available in the Workshop 
- Materials required to train or craft will also appear when you click on the green arrow.  
- Build area on Mars is slightly expanded to more closely match with the edge of background mountains
- Paver construction material is renamed to Pavement
- Modular habitat upgrade crafting requirements are reduced
- Storage building capacity is increased to 250 units
- When you demolish the building, previously used construction materials are reclaimed.
- Ganymede excavator unit description now includes materials that excavators can extract. 
- Notification icon will appear when your storage is full.
- Messages will no longer repeat when you terraform Mars.
- Fast-forwarding the game will mute voice messages.
- Building rotation is now properly saved.
- Tweeks to engineer’s pathfinding.
- A different color for the temperature needle in the mine.

notes.title: v1.0 LAUNCH!
notes.content:
After five months of Early Access, we're finally launching the game! Big thank you to those of you who voted for us on Greenlight and everyone during Early Access for your feedback and support. We tried to implement as much community feedback as possible. We will continue to build and expand this game based on your feedback. We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: v0.91 - Combat survival mode!
notes.content:
Tired of building stuff? Or you want to try out different defense strategies to defend Ceres? Try the new Combat survival game mode! Deploy turrets to defend your military base on Saturn’s moon Titan.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11897665/3c2fd9e10ab231dbe4280f3ffbb2f3d56d4ed5e1.jpg[/img]

You can place turrets on strategic locations and then take matters into your own hands. You can enter any turret and manually fire.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11897665/91f4a61d235d89a2eba4d3722f24d718c9465526.jpg[/img]

If you survive a new achievement is waiting.

Also you can now manually control turrets in the campaign mode as well.

notes.title: Major update available v0.90!
notes.content:
A new major update is now available! Now you can play three story campaigns all at once. Survive an unexpected conflict on Ceres and unravel a mystery on Ganymede. You can switch between three storylines at any moment. Make a colony life easier trough trading items between worlds. Ceres and Ganymede colonies now have a unique set of buildings and units.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11897665/98e4b62a1d2e7e3b219537c483fe341f2ec9916e.jpg[/img]

Combat layer is now part of campaigns. Construct various defense structures to protect your colonies. Build railgun, missile and laser turrets, military bases, combat drones and train troops.

Now you can pause and adjust the game speed.

A better in-game options screen now has many additional options to adjust your video settings and change resolution without quitting the game.

New set of achievements is also available.

If you minimize the game or run it in a window mode, game can now properly run in background.

Now that all three story campaigns are set up we will be able to release future updates more frequently, adding new features and fixing bugs. Some of new features in upcoming updates will include:

A brand new AI pathfinding for astronauts
Manual turret control
First person mode
Combat survival missions

notes.title: Version v0.81 is now available.
notes.content:
A new version v0.81 release notes. What’s new:

- To free storage space now is possible to remove unwanted items from a colony storage by clicking on a trash bin icons in a colony storage window.
- A new set of buildings specific to Ceres and Ganymede colonies. To accelerate development of new colonies now you can build a transport hub to receive and store production materials from Mars. Then you can quickly setup essential infrastructure to begin mining of the local resources.
- Tooltips are now mouse over popups.
- Message notification when you receive materials from another colony.
- Material icon will animate above the building when a production queue is complete.
- Apartments bug is fixed.
- Cobalt on Ceres bug is fixed.
- An earthquake bug that can destroy an entire colony is fixed.
- Now you can clear all items from a building queue.
- In the options window now you can choose not to display tutorial messages.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Z1EtcTd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New major update available! v0.80
notes.content:
New major update is now available! Now you can build a three colonies on a different worlds at the same time. This version also has a sandbox mode. At this moment a Mars terraforming campaign is fully playable while the next update will add campaigns to Ceres and Ganymede together with a combat layer.

We highly recommend starting a new game when playing this new version! Old save files might work but due to a major gameplay overhaul using an old save game file can cause unpredictable behaviour.

GUI is completely redesigned to match the new style of gameplay. Also money is no longer used as a resource in game. Levelling system is also excluded from this version. New structures and units will become available once you provide a necessary construction materials.

Now some buildings are producing materials needed to construct other buildings, craft new items and build units. Specific materials are only available on some worlds. That means you will have to develop all three colonies at the same time to gather all the necessary materials.

Some materials can only be extracted in mines, therefore mining is becoming a very important aspect of the game. To conduct a mining operations first you must build a mining vehicle in the factory that will survey the map and place probes on the ore rich spots. Click on the probe to see a survey report and then place a mining facility close by.

To exchange materials between colonies you must build a landing pad to receive materials and a launch pad or maglev launcher to send materials. 

A new units such as a flying repair drone will aid your astronauts in keeping your colony in good shape. 

Many new features and gameplay changes are in this version so please expect a few bugs here and there. We are working hard to bring you a new update as soon as possible while we continue to implement community feedback into the game. Looking forward to hear your comments and suggestions regarding this new update. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Development news
notes.content:
Just a quick update regarding game development. We are very busy implementing a whole bunch of new improvements based on a recent community feedback. Including a new user interface skin and a flying maintenance drone that will aid engineers in repairing buildings. Most of our work right now is focused on a two new colonies: Ceres in a the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter and Ganymede, Jupiter’s largest moon. Ceres will be a combat oriented campaign and will feature deployment of a defence system to repel ground and space attacks against a mining colony. Ganymede campaign will feature an exploration of the subsurface ocean. We are also working on a sandbox mode for all three maps. 

In order to release a new update we have to finish both new maps. To work properly, a game mechanics now require managing all three worlds at the same time. We are working day and night to bring you a new update as soon as possible. Please stay tuned for a new development updates!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4MZTti5.jpg[/img]
